full_prompt_en: A square, softly distressed painted image shows a woman in side profile standing in a dense red field. She occupies the right half of the frame and faces left, her head slightly lowered. Dark brown hair is gathered into a low bun, leaving her pale face and neck sharply visible against a broad muted teal sky. Her long red dress has a bright vermilion shoulder and sleeve, then darkens through the waist and lower half until its edges merge with the red vegetation. Small dark marks suggest clustered stems around her hands and skirt. The field fills a little less than the lower half, its upper edge running almost level across the image. Instead of detailed flowers, the surface is built from irregular rust, scarlet, and near-black flecks, with a slightly smoky lower band. In the open sky, a loose chain of tiny black birds crosses above and to the left of her head. Their uneven spacing introduces a delicate diagonal movement into the otherwise still composition. The light is diffuse and subdued, leaving few cast shadows; the pale profile, bright sleeve, and darker hair provide the clearest modeling. Fine grain, small worn specks, and soft rubbed areas roughen the color fields. The image feels quiet and somewhat distant, with only a few distinct contours emerging from expansive teal and red areas. The strong horizontal divide, isolated vertical silhouette, and scattered birds give the frame a restrained, melancholy rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、表面略显磨旧的绘画图像呈现一位女子侧身站在浓密红色原野中。她位于画面右半，朝向左侧，头微微低垂。深棕色头发在脑后盘成低发髻，使浅色脸庞与颈部在大片低饱和蓝绿色天空前清晰可见。长红裙的肩部和袖子明亮朱红，腰部与下半逐渐变暗，边缘最终融入红色植被。细小深色痕迹暗示她双手与裙边周围成簇的茎叶。原野占据略少于下半幅，上缘几乎水平横贯画面。表面没有细致花朵，而是由不规则铁锈红、猩红和近黑色碎点构成，下部略带烟雾般的暗带。空旷天空里，一串松散的小黑鸟从她头部上方和左侧掠过。参差的间距给原本静止的构图加入轻微对角线运动。光漫散而低调，几乎没有投影；浅色侧脸、亮红袖和深发提供最清楚的塑形。细颗粒、小块磨损斑点与柔和擦痕使色域变粗糙。画面安静而略有距离感，少量明确轮廓从宽阔蓝绿与红色色域中浮出。强烈的水平分界、孤立竖向剪影和零散飞鸟，让整个画幅具有克制而忧郁的节奏。
style_prompt_en: The image uses two broad, nearly horizontal color fields: muted green-blue above and layered rusty red below. A narrow, upright dark form interrupts their boundary, with one bright vermilion area and a small pale highlight creating the focal contrast. Details remain sparse and slightly softened; isolated near-black marks are scattered across open space with irregular intervals. Edges vary from clean at the lightest contour to rubbed and dissolving where dark passages meet the textured ground. Fine analog-looking grain, worn flecks, and smoky scumbling give the matte surface a weathered character. Illumination is diffuse and subdued, with gentle modeling and almost no hard shadow. The composition feels still, spacious, and restrained, its energy concentrated in the red-green complement and a few tiny directional accents.
style_prompt_zh: 画面使用两片宽阔、近乎水平的色域：上部是低饱和蓝绿，下部是层叠的铁锈红。狭窄竖向深色形体切断两者边界，一处明亮朱红和小块浅色亮面形成视觉焦点。细节稀少而略柔化；孤立的近黑色痕迹以不规则间隔散在开阔空间。边缘从最亮轮廓处的清楚线条，变化到深色段落与有肌理底面相接时的擦损与消散。细密的旧照片般颗粒、磨旧碎点和烟雾状擦涂使哑光表面带有风化感。照明漫散、低调，塑形轻柔，几乎没有硬阴影。构图静止、宽敞而克制，能量集中在红绿对照和几个极小的方向性重音。
theme_en: A woman in red standing in a field beneath scattered birds
theme_zh: 红衣女子立在有零散飞鸟的原野中
name: Rimel Neffati
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
